name: 90089 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90089 (Los Angeles) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90089 (Los Angeles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90089 (Los Angeles) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).
